text: The Claude adapter v0.101.0 declares `_meta.claudeCode.promptQueueing`. A `session/prompt` sent during a turn gets its own reply, in order. Claude Code hands it to the model mid-turn with the next tool result, yet the adapter answers the first prompt only when the whole turn ends, so coax shows it as queued until then. A `session/cancel` cancels every prompt received so far. Seen live 2026-11-10. Source: `startTurn` and `cancelTurns` in the adapter's bundled JavaScript.
